title: Refitter: Unrestricted OpenAPI references permit build-host SSRF and file inclusion (CVE-2026-63184)
description: Refitter versions prior to 2.1.1 have a vulnerability in their OpenAPI $ref resolution that allows build-time server-side request forgery (SSRF), remote file inclusion (RFI), and local file inclusion (LFI). This occurs because Refitter fetches remote HTTP(S) URLs and reads local files, including absolute paths and directory traversal outside the input directory, when inlining referenced schemas. The issue is confirmed in Refitter 2.0.0. No remote code execution is possible, but sensitive local files can be disclosed and untrusted remote content included during build. A fix is available in version 2.1.1 that restricts $ref resolution to prevent these behaviors.
